s.how: Butterfly 500g green prawns. Heat 3 tbsp olive oil until very hot, add the prawns with 4 sliced garlic cloves and a pinch of chilli flakes and cook 2 minutes. Add 80ml white wine, bubble for a minute, then swirl in 30g butter and chopped parsley. Serve in the pan with crusty bread for the juices.

Cut 400g low-moisture mozzarella into 16 fingers and freeze 20 minutes. Dip in 50g flour, then 2 beaten eggs, then 100g breadcrumbs, then egg and crumbs again. Fry at 180C for 90 seconds until golden. Warm 250ml passata with a pinch of salt and oregano for dipping.

m.note: for the Japanese restaurant scene where nobody takes their shoes off
m.how: Simmer 80ml soy sauce, 80ml mirin, 60ml sake and 2 tbsp sugar for 5 minutes until syrupy. Sear 4 sirloin steaks, about 800g, in a smoking pan for 3 minutes a side, brushing with glaze in the last minute. Rest 5 minutes and slice. Serve with 400g steamed short grain rice and 4 blanched bok choy.

w.how: Drain 750g fresh ricotta in a sieve for 2 hours. Beat with 150g caster sugar, 4 eggs, the zest of 1 lemon and 1 tsp vanilla extract until smooth. Pour into a lined 22cm springform tin and bake at 160C for 60 minutes. Turn off the oven and cool inside with the door ajar. Dust with icing sugar to serve.

d.note: Sonny Black's social club, where everyone drinks Scotch
d.how: Put 4 heavy tumblers in the freezer for 15 minutes. Into a jug of ice pour 200ml blended Scotch, 80ml sweet vermouth and 8 dashes aromatic bitters. Stir for 30 seconds until very cold, then strain into the tumblers over a large ice cube each. Twist a strip of orange peel over each glass, drop it in and add a cocktail cherry.
